semiconductor_relevance: High — Hibiki Seiki manufactures precision parts for semiconductor manufacturing equipment, focusing on complex machining and technology transfer.
summary: Hibiki Seiki specializes in manufacturing precision components for semiconductor manufacturing equipment, with a strong emphasis on complex machining techniques. The company is committed to fostering technology and skills transfer, ensuring high-quality production through continuous training and development of its workforce.
capabilities: Complex precision cutting using lathes and machining centers
Manufacturing parts primarily from aluminum and stainless steel
Development of proprietary software for order placement and production management

regional_presence.Japan: Hibiki Seiki aims to be a leading group of craftsmen in Japan, focusing on high-quality production and technology transfer.
